div.head: II Eg 4.2
div.ab: ⁊ gyf he hine eft syllan nylle, læde hine eft to Róme ⁊ oðre swylce bote; ⁊ þonne he ham cume, gylde þam cynge twahund scill'.
⁊ gyf he hine eft syllan nelle, læde hine eft to Rome ⁊ oðere swilce bote; ⁊ þonne he ham cume, gylde þam cinge twahund scyllinga.
Et si iterum reddere nolit, deferat eum Romam iterum et eandem emendationem; et cum redierit, emendet CC sol. regi.
⁊ gif he hine eft sillan nelle, læde hine eft to Rome ⁊ oðre swilce bote; ⁊ þonne he ham cume, gilde þam cynge twahund scill'.
And gyf he hine eft syllan nylle, læde hine eft to Rome and oðre swylce bote; and þonne he ham cume, gylde þam cynge twahund scillinga.
And if he again refuses to give it, he shall take it again to Rome, and hand over the same sum as compensation, and when he comes home, he shall pay 200 shillings to the king.
And if he refuses to pay a second time, he is to take the payment again to Rome along with the same amount as a penalty; and when he has returned, he is to pay two hundred shillings to the king.
And if again he will not pay it, he is again to take it to Rome, with another such compensation; and when he comes home, he is to pay 200 shillings to the king.
Und wenn er zum zweiten Male sich weigert, den [Peterspfennig] zu geben, trage er ihn wiederum nach Rom mit einer zweiten solchen Busssumme; und wenn er heimkommt, zahle er dem König 200 Schill.
And if he again refuses to give the [Peter's Penny], let him take it to Rome again with a second such penalty; and when he comes home, let him pay the king 200 shillings.
